item.title: Happy Live, Show Up: Encore!!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FAVORITE
  • 発売日: 2023-06-30
  • スコア: 7.290000000000001/10 (64 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ハッピーライヴ ショウアップ アンコール！！
  • 英語名: Happy Live, Show Up: Encore!!

あらすじ

Akito, the main character, visits the land where he used to live in order to meet Miyabi, who has been in a long-distance relationship. It brings about an unexpected change of heart and greatly changes the destinies of the two. The main story is a close-up after story of Miyabi Asahina, and the mini-story of Sophia, Katya, Lou, Clarisse, and Pechica & co. are also included!

item.title: Happy Live, Show Up!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FAVORITE
  • 発売日: 2021-05-28
  • スコア: 7.5/10 (162 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ハッピーライヴ ショウアップ！
  • 英語名: Happy Live, Show Up!

别名

  • ハラショウ！

あらすじ

The long, harsh Russian winter had ended, and Spring was in the air.

On one particular day, Laikask Academy second-year Akito Yukihara was walking down the street when he stumbled upon a crying lost child. He decided to help the child find her parents, and was joined by Sofia Tulina, who happened to be present at the scene. Also, to get the child to stop crying, he put on a small magic show for her.

item.title: AstralAir no Shiroki Towa Finale -Shiroki Hoshi no Yume-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FAVORITE
  • 発売日: 2017-01-27
  • スコア: 7.890000000000001/10 (217 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アストラエアの白き永遠 Finale -白き星の夢-
  • 英語名: AstralAir no Shiroki Towa Finale -Shiroki Hoshi no Yume-

あらすじ

The town of Tsukigasaki has entered its third year of winter.

Showing the seasons no mind, the snow only continues to fall.

Gently, swaying in the air, as it descends downwards.

That snow, which never had reached the ground, now does.

The cityscape, once bleak, is now a blanket of glistening white.

item.title: Akai Hitomi ni Utsuru Sekai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FAVORITE
  • 発売日: 2015-07-24
  • スコア: 7.890000000000001/10 (387 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 紅い瞳に映るセカイ
  • 英語名: Akai Hitomi ni Utsuru Sekai

别名

  • A World Reflected in Red Eyes

あらすじ

This is a fandisc for the Irotoridori no Sekai series, focusing on everyone’s favourite hotcake-loving magician Shinku. Yuuma and Shinku return to Arashiyama-sou for a short visit with their precious daughter Sora. Their friends hear about their arrival and returned to spend time with them under the same roof like old times. They have finally achieved the normal days which they had yearned for, and it is full of bright smiles and happiness.

item.title: AstralAir no Shiroki Towa
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FAVORITE
  • 発売日: 2014-07-25
  • スコア: 8.1/10 (502 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アストラエアの白き永遠
  • 英語名: AstralAir no Shiroki Towa

别名

  • 星辰少女的白色永远

あらすじ

For two years, snow had been falling continuously in the town of Tsukigasaki with spring nowhere in sight. Aside from the snow which never built up, the town was also struck by other abnormal incidents, such as tornadoes, thunderbolts and floods. Riku is an ‘elfin’ who possesses a mysterious ability known as ‘rune’, which he uses to save others. He returned to Tsukigasaki, where he grew up in an orphanage, along with fellow elfins Rinne and Hinata. Their duty was to protect two young sisters, Ochiba and Hazuki, from rune abilities which go out of control, while also keeping the existence of elfins a secret to the public.

  • 日本語名: いろとりどりのセカイ
  • 英語名: Irotoridori no Sekai

别名

  • いろとりどりのセカイ

あらすじ

Our story follows Kanoue Yuuma, an amnesiac boy with a special power, and Nikaidou Shinku, a translucent girl only visible to Yuuma who gave him that power. With it, he can heal any and all wounds.

But it comes at the cost of the memories he’s made.

He lives a simple life: going to school and being scolded by his childhood friend, Kisaragi Mio, by day, and working with his master, Natsume Suzu, in the evenings.

item.title: Happy☆Margaret!

  • 英語名: Happy☆Margaret!

别名

  • Happy Marguerite!

あらすじ

Chiaki and his old friend Inaho were ordinary high school students. They lived an ordinary and peaceful life until they meet with a maid on their way from school. “I’m Sakura. Nice to meet you.” She said and somehow they lost consciousness.

When Chiaki woke up, he found himself in a strange place, alone. Soon he learned that this place was an academy of sorts and he was accepted as a student. What will become of him in this strange place and what happened to his childhood friend Inaho?

item.title: Wiz Anniversary
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FAVORITE

  • スコア: 7.18/10 (56 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ウィズ アニバーサリィー
  • 英語名: Wiz Anniversary

あらすじ

This is a story of a traditional magic school. Duo is forced to enter this school. He takes his school life with smart students, rich students, strange students, sisters, seniors and teachers. Bustling life, magic, wonder, a few secrets and studying magic. Also, the festival for witches “Wiz Anniversary” takes place. What will happen next in this slapstick life with heroines?
